integrity: Analytical proof given with a standalone finite-check script. Numerical checks do not establish universal claims. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional full-column-rank real Landweber with one fixed isotropic Gaussian observation, nonoscillatory relaxation 0<omega*lambda_max<=1. Pairwise rank order assumes distinct normal eigenvalues. Covariance compression is not reconstruction error or uncertainty interval coverage. Historical priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Single-crossing covariance spectrum and moving optimal ranks for Landweber iteration
